    The dichotomy step, split #

    CoverDichotomy follows from two steps (coverDichotomy_of):

    • CriticalPieceCarriesPair: a finite convex piece of the universal cover that is representation-infinite, with every convex piece of fewer points representation-finite (a critical piece), carries a Kronecker pair;
    • RepFinitePiecesGiveBand: if every finite convex piece is representation-finite, the algebra has a monomial band.

    Representation-finiteness of a piece S (PieceRepFin) is stated for representations of its quiver that satisfy the relations of the cover.
